parsed.subject: Poor mobile signal at [Your address]
parsed.body_markdown:
Dear Mobile Operator,

I am writing about poor mobile signal at my home, [Your address] (54.44500, -3.10500). Residents here experience weak or unreliable mobile coverage.

Evidence:
- No operator has a clear line of sight to an identified mast site from this location [network_comparison] (computed from line of sight and sites; OpenCelliD, OpenStreetMap and Ofcom WTR downloaded 2026-10-25).
- The nearest approximate mast site is 3.8 km south-east (Vodafone, inferred from crowd-sourced data) [nearest_site] (OpenCelliD downloaded 2026-10-25).
- O2’s nearest approximate site is 5.7 km south-east [los_o2] (Copernicus DEM GLO-30; source data 2011-2015).
- Terrain rises above the direct line to identified sites for EE, O2, Three and Vodafone, so signals are likely weakened rather than lost [los_ee][los_o2][los_three][los_vodafone] (Copernicus DEM GLO-30; source data 2011-2015).
- No Ookla speed tests were recorded in this cell or within 1 km in 2026Q3 [speed_cell][speed_1km] (Ookla open data tiles).

Likely causes: terrain blocking is likely; distance to mast is possibly a factor; weather is possibly a factor for current degradation only. These causes are inferred from public data and cannot be confirmed without on-site measurement.

Please review mobile coverage at this location and tell us whether an upgrade, a new site, or additional operators at an existing site are planned.

Yours sincerely,
[Your name]
[Your address]
